title: Lock Tampered With
content: The lock was forced open with a pry bar, not a key. The storm's electrical surge may have disabled the alarm.

title: Large Footprint
content: The footprint is size 12, consistent with the assistant's work boots.

title: Wool Cloth
content: The torn cloth is from a blue wool uniform, like the security guard's coat.

title: Dust Pattern
content: The dust in the box is undisturbed except for a clean circle exactly the size of the sapphire. It wasn't moved recently.

title: Duplicate Key
content: The master key is missing. The assistant recently asked the curator for access to make a copy for 'emergency'.

title: Umbrella Contradiction
content: The curator claimed she didn't go out, but her umbrella is wet. She must have lied.

title: Muddy Gloves
content: The gloves have mud matching the footprint's mud. They also have traces of metal shavings.

title: Missing Pry Bar
content: A heavy pry bar is missing from the assistant's toolbox. It could have been used to break the lock.

title: Sapphire Recovered
content: The sapphire was hidden in the telescope mount on the rooftop. Only someone with knowledge of the observatory would know that spot.

title: Rope Used
content: The rope is tied to the dome railing and shows signs of recent climbing. The thief escaped via the roof during the storm.

title: Assistant's Motive
content: The assistant had gambling debts and needed money. He was overheard arguing with the curator about a loan.

title: Security Alibi
content: The security guard was checking the perimeter when the alarm went off. His log shows he was at the east gate at the time of the heist.
